dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "-m", "jupyter_server"]
explanation: The requirements.txt includes jupyter_server with a pinned version for stability. The Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim as the base image, sets up the working directory, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, copies the application code, and sets the default command to run the jupyter_server module.
